The windows and brickwork on the background buildings lack sharp geometric lines, appearing smeared or melted, typical of generative blur.
The wheel of the cart seems to fuse with the ground and the central mast structure lacks clear mechanical connectivity. It looks like a single melted mass rather than assembled parts.
